seat.about: Anika has been coming for about a year and you have never had a problem worth ringing about, which is exactly why one this week would rattle you.
goals: Find out whether Anika is charged for the session she missed while she was ill.

life.3: Anika has a fever. She is not going tomorrow evening and you have not told anybody yet.
life.5: Anika is still off. You have started wondering what you are paying for.

seat.about: Two children in two different classes, and you have never once been told what the pair of them costs you as one number.
goals: Get one figure for both children, for the month, that you can plan around.

seat.about: You left your name on the enquiry pad weeks ago and nobody rang back. You have two children and you are pricing three places at once.
goals: Get a straight price for two children before you commit to anything.
Find out whether there is a sibling discount, and get a real answer either way.
